messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=redwood-infer-infer-east-3; alert=vram_drain_sustained; severity=high; sustained VRAM 95%+ for 130s. link: https://pd.example/INC12345 · runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/gpu-vram-drain
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 created · urgent · responder: @oncall-alex
oncall-alex: Acked on PD — picking up. I’m on call for next 30m. Starting triage.
oncall-alex: quick triage command: `kubectl -n infer logs -l pool=infer-east-3 --tail=200 | grep -i cuda | tail -n 50` — seeing repeated "CUDA: out of memory" and "failed alloc" lines.
infra-maya: Confirming metrics — headroom collapse during batching spikes. Last deploy? checking.
eng-luca: Heads-up: we rolled out v2-compact to infer-east-3 ~6h ago, could have larger VRAM footprint under certain seq lengths.
oncall-alex: Applying emergency throttle: `redwoodctl pools update infer-east-3 --set batch_limit=512` — will watch impact. :wrench:
pagerduty-bot: Change noted by Alex; waiting 90s for stabilization window.
support-zoe: Customer ACME (prod) called in — reports latency spikes and 500s starting ~11:03 UTC. I've told them we're investigating and may route to fallback.
oncall-alex: Metrics after throttle: VRAM ~96% -> ~78% in ~30s, CUDA alloc errors decreased in logs. Continuing to monitor for 10m.
infra-maya: Initiating small traffic shift: add +10% weight to infer-west-1 for 5m to reduce pool load (will revert automatically). :left_right_arrow:
eng-luca: Preparing rollback plan: revert subset from v2-compact -> v2-stable if we see reoccurrence. Rolling image warmups ready.
oncall-jordan: I'm on deck in 18m for handoff. alex — please leave notes for next: commands run, metrics change, customer notified.
oncall-alex: Handoff summary: throttled batch_limit=512, +10% traffic to west, watching CUDA alloc logs, customer notified. If failures recur: escalate PD to infra-team, prepare full rollback and a controlled drain of infer-east-3. Marking INC12345 as "investigating". :white_check_mark:
